transcript: Quote for Dr. Angela Martinez, 310 Oak Ridge Lane. Master bathroom toilet was rocking and leaking at the base. Replaced the subfloor flange with a repair flange kit, put on two wax rings, stacked wax rings. Customer had us supply a Kohler toilet which cost two hundred twenty dollars. Took one hour and forty-five minutes of labor. All done and sealed.

expected.job_summary: Replaced toilet flange, wax rings, and installed Kohler toilet
expected.notes: Master bathroom toilet leaking at base.
